description: Non-material amendment (fenestration) of Non-material amendments reference 23/3812 dated 6 December, 2023, for Non-material amendment to Condition 1 of full planning permissions reference 23/2838 dated 16/11/2023 for Proposed two storey side and rear extension, hip to gable conversion, rear dormer window with Juliet balcony and 7x rooflights, external alterations to front elevation of the building, soft landscaping to front garden,instillation of refuse storage, cycle parking and electric vehicle charging points within front garden, and internal alterations to facilitate the proposed change of use from single dwelling house (C3) to a large HMO (Sui Generis),.as follows:Replace "The development hereby approved shall be completed with 1 year of the date of this permission.Reason: To ensure that the breach of planning control is remedied in a timely fashion" with following:"The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning on the date of this permission. Reason:  To conform with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990."
